svg.title: Authorization checks before and during testing
svg.desc: Supplement: check the agreement before each new action; stop and clarify uncertainty. Confirm approval: An appropriate authority approves the testers, environment and targets. Check the action: Proceed only when target, method, data and time fit the agreement. At a boundary: Unlisted targets, incidents or an expired window: stop affected testing and report. Resume and close: Resume as authorized; minimize evidence, report findings and complete agreed cleanup.
svg.text: Authorization checks before and during testing
An appropriate authority approves the testers, environment and targets.
Proceed only when target, method, data and time fit the agreement.
Unlisted targets, incidents or an expired window: stop affected testing and report.
Resume as authorized; minimize evidence, report findings and complete agreed cleanup.
